$note: A hand-built pattern catalogue for the Surface Spec tests and for the `aof-tools ui spec validate --patterns` probe (objective 34-04). W1b has NO pinned eden-ui-flutter release, so the real catalogue is unreachable and the CLI arm's default is `undefined` — which I5 reports as PAT000/MISSING. This file exists so I5's real codes (PAT001, PAT002) are reachable from the REAL binary: a gate that cannot fail for one of its own known-broken fixtures is the verification trap this objective exists to close. Entry shape: a bare id string, or {id, kind?, must_not?} — `kind` binds the pattern to a control kind, and `must_not` is the negation set a control of that kind INHERITS and may not silently drop (§4.5 I5).
